level1_releases.body_excerpt:
This is a gateway-only `extended-stable` release, which is our current equivalent to LTS. This release is OpenClaw from the end of October 2026, plus critical security updates, reliability and performance fixes, and features like new model support. The latest version of OpenClaw at the time of this release is [2026.11.5](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/releases#release-v2026.11.5)

## 2026.10.33

This extended-stable release brings cumulative Gateway and core-plugin improvements since 2026.9.37, plus the selected maintenance fixes on the approved 2026.11.4 product baseline. Distribution covers the core npm package, matching official npm plugins, and Gateway Docker images; native-app releases are not included.

### Highlights

- Long conversations and large session stores use bounded export and recovery work, reducing out-of-memory failures during chat, memory export, Doctor repair, and Gateway startup. (#194066, #196158, #195459, #196480, #176737, #181289) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa, @vincentkoc, @ericcaiwx-star, @obviyus, @garrytan, and @oxen-horse.
- Interrupted updates recover when their executor dies instead of leaving the Gateway stuck offline, while version-skew checks protect state still used by an installed service. (#181695, #186971, #187819) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa, @PonySlayer28, @tomdailey55, @jalehman, @fuller-stack-dev, and @vincentkoc.
- Replies survive more restart and reconnect paths, preserving original prompts, recovering Telegram responses, and avoiding lost WhatsApp replies or skipped Signal messages. (#187157, #195400, #168778, #187667) Thanks @shakkernerd, @jason-allen-oneal, @mcaxtr, @HermanZeng, and @obviyus.
- Shared-session privacy is stronger: Side chat stays private to its viewer, internal model prompts stay out of displayed output, and compaction redacts credentials in quoted summaries. (#185390, #173460, #197349) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @Satoshi-Kusumoto, @RomneyDa, @zhangguiping-xydt, @Patrick-Erichsen, and @obviyus.
- Automations can react to polled conditions and MCP events, run repeatable scripts, and use explicitly allowed MCP servers. (#101195, #165399, #160996, #160995) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @obviyus.
- Installed skills can be searched and read on demand, helping agents find relevant instructions without putting every installed skill into the prompt. (#158089, #158090, #158091, #160538) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa and @vincentkoc.

- Added WebRTC negotiation for realtime voice calls in the TUI. (#61172)
- Added automatically refreshed authentication headers for OpenTelemetry HTTP exporters. (#61028)
- Added experimental support for using identically named MCP servers across environments. (#60905)

## Bug Fixes
- Oversized WebSocket requests now fall back to HTTP without unnecessary retries. (#60840, #60841)
- Fixed MCP OAuth credential races during cancellation, login, and logout. (#60849, #60981)
- Improved automatic reconnection for Cloud conversations and preserved active recovery turns when clients reconnect. (#60969, #61014)

level1_releases.name: v2.1.327
level1_releases.body_excerpt:
## What's changed

- Added a confirmation before `/install-github-app` changes a repository
- Added `claude mcp add-json <name> -` to read the server's JSON from stdin, so tokens can stay off the command line; not available inside a Claude Code session
- Added a line when a resumed session's earlier messages can't be loaded
- Added a list in `/status` of broken agent, skill, command and output style files, keybinding errors, an unavailable sandbox, ignored permission settings and hook matchers that never match
- Added a note in `/config` when other settings override a row
- Added `x-claude-code-managed-settings-checksum` to the gateway hint headers; sent where managed settings set `CLAUDE_CODE_GATEWAY_HINT_HEADERS=1`, including where they already do
- Added support for naming a session's billing group with the `attributionProject` setting, for Claude apps gateways that set `admin.billing_group_tag`
- Added `/tui classic` as the name for the non-fullscreen renderer; `/tui default` still works
- Remote Control: Fixed stopping the server in worktree mode deleting a running session's git-ignored files, such as `.env`
- Fixed self-hosted runners with `--use-anthropic-git-proxy` deleting a non-empty directory named by `GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL` at startup: the runner now keeps it, ignores the variable and warns
- Fixed `claude mcp add` and `claude mcp remove` with project scope deleting other top-level keys from `.mcp.json`, such as `$schema` or another tool's `servers`
- Fixed `/export` overwriting an existing file without asking: the dialog now asks, and `/export <name>` keeps the file and says to run `/export`
- Fixed a command you had allowed still running after you pressed Stop, when the approval arrived after a restart, in cloud and self-hosted runner sessions with no feature flags loaded
- Fixed Enter closing `/teleport`'s load error screen
- Fixed a click followed by Enter in `/plugin` installing or disabling a plugin
- Fixed a half-typed `!` command running on an extra Enter after the usage limit menu
- Fixed some `--disallowedTools` rules with parentheses in their content
- Fixed auto mode ignoring some wildcard PowerShell allow rules that name a script with `.\`, such as `PowerShell(.\scripts\build.ps1 *)`
- Fixed a running Code Mode script in auto mode getting permission prompts and denials once Claude started a second script that auto mode also allowed
- Changed some pre-started background sessions to be discarded after an account change
- Changed a workfl
